arxiv-2111-13180.title: Variational Gibbs Inference for Statistical Model Estimation from Incomplete Data
arxiv-2111-13180.creator: Vaidotas Simkus vaidotas.simkus@ed.ac.uk
arxiv-2111-13180.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vaidotas Simkus vaidotas.simkus@ed.ac.uk. Statistical models are central to machine learning with broad applicability across a range of downstream tasks. The models are controlled by free parameters that are typically estimated from data by maximum-likelihood estimation or approximations thereof. However, when faced with real-world data sets many of the models run into a critical issue: they are formulated in terms of fully-observed data, whereas in practice the data sets are plagued with missing data.

arxiv-2203-12426.title: Impact of demand growth on decarbonizing India’s electricity sector and the role for energy storage
arxiv-2203-12426.creator: Marc Barbar, Dharik S. Mallapragada, Robert Stoner
arxiv-2203-12426.description: Abstract Global energy sector decarbonization efforts are contingent on technology choices for energy production and end-use in emerging markets such as India, where air conditioning is expected to be a major driver for electricity demand growth. Here, we use an integrated demand-supply framework to quantify the impacts of demand growth and temporal patterns on long-term electricity system evolution.

arxiv-2210-00201.title: Integrating Conventional Headway Control with Reinforcement Learning to Avoid Bus Bunching
arxiv-2210-00201.creator: Xiheng Wang
arxiv-2210-00201.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiheng Wang. Bus bunching is a natural-occurring phenomenon that undermines the efficiency and stability of the public transportation system. The mainstream solutions control the bus to intentionally stay longer at certain stations. Existing control methods include conventional methods that provide a formula to calculate the control time and reinforcement learning (RL) methods that determine the control policy through repeated interactions with the system. In this paper, we propose an integrated proximal policy optimization model with dual-headway (IPPO-DH).

arxiv-2302-13573.title: Spherical Wavefronts Improve MU-MIMO Spectral Efficiency When Using Electrically Large Arrays
arxiv-2302-13573.creator: Giacomo Bacci, Luca Sanguinetti, Emil Björnson
arxiv-2302-13573.description: Abstract Modern MIMO ( MIMO ) communication systems are almost exclusively designed under the assumption of locally plane wavefronts over antenna arrays. This is known as the far-field approximation and is soundly justified at sub-6-GHz frequencies at most relevant transmission ranges.

arxiv-2409-08403.title: A Successive Refinement for Solving Stochastic Programs with Decision-Dependent Random Capacities
arxiv-2409-08403.creator: Hugh Medal, Samuel Affar
arxiv-2409-08403.description: Abstract We study a class of two-stage stochastic programs in which the second stage includes a set of components with uncertain capacity, and the expression for the distribution function of the uncertain capacity includes first-stage variables. Thus, this class of problems has the characteristics of a stochastic program with decision-dependent uncertainty.

arxiv-2507-14041.title: Extreme value distribution for GRB prompt data
arxiv-2507-14041.creator: S. Covino
arxiv-2507-14041.description: Abstract Context. Gamma-Ray Bursts (GRBs) are known to be unpredictable in time and position. A few (observationally) exceptional events have been observed, as GRB 221009A that stands out for its fluence and peak flux, being orders of magnitude higher than what measured so far. Aims.

arxiv-2512-03054.title: Energy-Efficient Federated Learning via Adaptive Encoder Freezing for MRI-to-CT Conversion: A Green AI-Guided Research
arxiv-2512-03054.creator: Ciro Benito Raggio, Lucia Migliorelli, Nils Skupien, Mathias Krohmer Zabaleta, Oliver Blanck, Francesco Cicone, Giuseppe Lucio Cascini, Paolo Zaffino, Maria Francesca Spadea
arxiv-2512-03054.description: Abstract Background and Objective : Federated Learning (FL) holds the potential to advance equality in health by enabling diverse institutions to collaboratively train deep learning (DL) models, even with limited data. However, the significant resource requirements of FL often exclude centres with limited computational infrastructure, further widening existing healthcare disparities.

pmc-10553485.title: THU516 An Unusual Neck Mass
pmc-10553485.creator: Paola Rios, Niketa Kalara, Tharun Shyam, Jaylou Velez, Carmen Gomez, Silvia Gra Menendez
pmc-10553485.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: Parathyroid carcinoma is a rare tumor which presents with a neck mass and hypercalcemia. Non-functional parathyroid tumors account for 10% of all parathyroid carcinomas and are associated with decrease or impaired secretion of PTH, having normal calcium, being difficult to diagnose. We present a case of a patient who presented with a neck mass and normocalcemia, who was diagnosed of non-functional parathyroid tumor, were immunohistochemistry played a useful role in differentiating an unsuspected parathyroid lesion from a thyroid neoplasm.

pmc-11436730.title: Glycemic variability’s impact on painful diabetic peripheral neuropathy in type 2 diabetes patients
pmc-11436730.creator: Kuo-Cheng Chang, Yen-Wei Pai, Ching-Heng Lin, I-Te Lee, Ming-Hong Chang
pmc-11436730.description: Hyperglycemia in type 2 diabetes leads to diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) and neuropathic pain, yet the association between glycemic variability and painful DPN remains insufficiently evidenced. To address this, we conducted a prospective longitudinal cohort study involving adult type 2 diabetes patients at a medical center.

pmc-11689060.title: TRANSITIONS INTO DEMENTIA: REFLECTIONS ON WALKING INTERVIEWS AND THE PHOTO-ELICITATION METHOD IN DEMENTIA STUDIES
pmc-11689060.creator: Simone Niedoba, Frank Oswald
pmc-11689060.description: Environmental gerontology highlights behavioral and experiential processes between a person and the environment in relation to different outcomes. However, how people living with early dementia experience and shape their environment is still poorly understood and how these processes could be best assessed is still being debated.

pmc-11738522.title: Management of Benzodiazepine Use in Youth and Young Adults: A Scoping Review
pmc-11738522.creator: Nia Kakamousias, Laura Miller, Selene Etches, Melanie MacInnis
pmc-11738522.description: AimsBenzodiazepines are commonly used medications that have the potential for dependence and use disorder. Despite these harms, they are regularly prescribed and acquired from non-prescription sources. It has been established that benzodiazepine use is a widespread problem in youth and young adults. Little evidence exists to guide management of benzodiazepine use in this population.

pmc-12394721.title: Cortex folding by combined progenitor expansion and adhesion-controlled neuronal migration
pmc-12394721.creator: Seung Hee Chun, Da Eun Yoon, D Santiago Diaz Almeida, Mihail Ivilinov Todorov, Tobias Straub, Tobias Ruff, Wei Shao, Jianjun Yang, Gönül Seyit-Bremer, Yi-Ru Shen, Ali Ertürk, Daniel del Toro, Songhai Shi, Rüdiger Klein
pmc-12394721.description: Folding of the mammalian cerebral cortex into sulcal fissures and gyral peaks is the result of complex processes that are incompletely understood. Previously we showed that genetic deletion of Flrt1/3 adhesion molecules causes folding of the smooth mouse cortex into sulci resulting from increased lateral dispersion and faster neuron migration, without progenitor expansion.

pmc-12923192.title: “It All Comes Down to the Teens”: An Actor-Partner-Interdependence Model of Trust, Engagement and Satisfaction With the School in Parent-Adolescent Dyads
pmc-12923192.creator: Petru Lucian Curșeu, Arcadius Florin Muntean, Mihai Tucaliuc
pmc-12923192.description: ObjectivesOur study underscores the relevance of focusing on parent-adolescent dyads in order to understand the interplay between school trust, engagement and satisfaction with the school by testing a model in which school engagement mediates the association between trust in the school and satisfaction with the school.

pmc-13118094.title: The Correlation Between PD-L1 Expression in Metaplastic Breast Cancer and Clinical-Pathological Features and Prognosis
pmc-13118094.creator: Tugba Toyran, Ertuğrul Bayram, Yasemin Aydınalp Camadan, Berksoy Sahin, Kubilay Dalcı, Yusuf Kemal Arslan, Melek Ergin
pmc-13118094.description: Background and Objectives: Metaplastic breast carcinoma (MBC) is a rare, aggressive malignancy that is often resistant to conventional chemotherapy and characterized by a triple-negative phenotype. While immune checkpoint inhibition shows promise, the prognostic significance and distribution of programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression within the heterogeneous architecture of MBC remain poorly understood.

pmc-13276778.title: A case of complete renal pedicle avulsion with deceptively stable hemodynamics: Critical diagnostic pitfall of misdiagnosis as ectopic kidney
pmc-13276778.creator: Xinji Yang, Herong Zhu, Xiaofei Hou, Ke Liu
pmc-13276778.description: We report a 42-year-old female with AAST Grade V renal trauma from blunt crush injury, who presented with hemodynamic stability despite surgically confirmed complete renal pedicle avulsion. Initial CT mimicked congenital ectopic kidney, risking misdiagnosis. The patient underwent emergency nephrectomy with favorable outcome. We elucidate the pathophysiology of this paradoxical phenomenon, and highlight its diagnostic pitfalls and management principles.

pmc-13639586.title: Epidemiology of Pufferfish Poisoning in Japan: Trends and Insights from 2004 to 2023
pmc-13639586.creator: Yoshiro Hadano, Yuichiro Tanaka, Satoshi Ohno
pmc-13639586.description: Introduction:Pufferfish poisoning caused by tetrodotoxin remains a serious and potentially fatal public health concern in Japan, despite stringent regulations governing its traditional consumption.Methods:Epidemiological trends in pufferfish poisoning over the past two decades were retrospectively analyzed using data from the Ministry of Health’s “Foodborne Illness Statistical Data” reports between January 2004 and December 2023.
